captions.detailed: This 3D model features a side-mounted cantilever robotic arm with three joints. It consists of a dark gray rectangular wall mount supporting a series of links: a primary orange arm segment, a secondary dark blue arm segment, and a light gray end-effector plate. The arm articulates via three revolute joints, allowing horizontal rotational movement at the shoulder, elbow, and wrist.
captions.instruction: Create a side-mounted robotic arm with a wall-mounting plate, an orange primary link, a blue secondary link, and a light gray end-effector plate. The assembly should feature three revolute joints to enable horizontal rotation at each pivot point.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a dark gray rectangular base plate with mounting holes. It then creates the primary link using an orange rectangular body with rounded, slotted ends, and a secondary link in dark blue with similar slotted detailing. The end-effector is modeled as a light gray square flange. These parts are sequentially connected using three revolute joint definitions that establish horizontal rotational axes.
